message:
Now let me compile the fuzzer with ASan. I need to rebuild the gpsd library with ASan first:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpsd && scons -Q clean 2>&1 | tail -5 && CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1" scons -Q 2>&1 | tail -10</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
